visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with manicured red and gold nails holds a gold-foil hand mask packet titled 'VITAMIN B3 ANTI-AGING HAND MASK' against a background of various skincare bottles on a white marble vanity. (2) Close-up shot of the bare hand displaying visible skin texture and wrinkles; the nails are meticulously painted with deep red and sparkling gold accents. (3) The hand holds up a pair of white, glove-shaped hand masks in front of a neutral-toned curtain background. (4) The person is seen wearing the white hand mask gloves, flexing their fingers to demonstrate the fit while standing in an indoor setting. (5) The scene shifts to a bedroom where the person sits on a bed with white linens; their gloved hands are visible while an iPad in the background plays an animated video. (6) A gloved hand interacts with a smartphone screen, tapping on social media icons to show the mask's touch-screen compatibility. (7) The mask is removed, and the bare hand is shown again under warm indoor lighting, appearing noticeably smoother and more hydrated. (8) Both hands are shown, one still gloved and one bare, comparing the results. (9) A low-angle shot shows the person sitting on a patterned rug, wearing both the white hand mask gloves and matching foot mask socks. (10) The video ends with a static black screen displaying a white website URL in the center.
